params.prompt:
Commercial-quality modern high-density pixel-art life simulation set in a fictional contemporary Korean city.

2.5D three-quarter elevated top-down open-world game perspective, consistent camera angle, believable architectural depth, layered foreground and background, clear walkable gameplay space, realistic human-scale entrances, sidewalks, roads and interiors.

Crisp deliberate pixel edges, consistent pixel density, grounded proportions, rich environmental storytelling, restrained palette, muted urban colors, warm practical interior lighting and controlled city lights.

The world looks ordinary and believable at first glance, but contains understated black comedy about work, education, money, debt, rent, investing, consumption and adulthood.

The humor must come from context and environmental storytelling rather than exaggerated jokes.

Original visual identity for Ian Growing.

Not voxel.
Not block-based.
Not photorealistic.
Not glossy 3D.
Not generic mobile game art.
Not fantasy.
Not cyberpunk.
No real brands.
No readable AI-generated Korean text.
Leave signage text areas blank for hand-authored Unity pixel text.

Use reference one's finance branch as geometry anchor and subsequent references for game density and scale. Calm, professionally lit modern bank branch: queuing area, chairs, low consultation desks, employees and waiting customers, display with abstract market lines, discreet loan pamphlets with blank text areas. At the most welcoming desk sits an unusually thick stack of plain folders and a tiny pen. Quiet commentary about debt and paperwork, otherwise perfectly normal. One clear walk from entrance to the advisor. Use a shallow fixed orthographic game camera looking north, camera pitched down about 35 degrees, horizontal east-west edges across the frame; visible floor/top and south-facing walls, no horizon, no vanishing points. Characters about 6 heads tall; an entry is about 1.25 times standing height. Draw a single contiguous game view with open lanes; never a collage or HUD. Use small pixel clusters, asphalt slate, concrete putty, muted teal, warm oat, ink blue and restrained amber.
